title: mediating-nucleus
description: For a family of worlds {W_i}, a connecting structure (M, {Q_i}, {ψ_i}): a nucleus M with hole subobjects Q_i ↪ M and portal morphisms ψ_i : Q_i → W_i into each world. A way-station among the worlds; mediators for a fixed family form a category whose morphisms are structure-preserving comparisons.

nucleus.description: the connecting nucleus M (an object of the ambient relational category)

holes.description: hole subobjects Q_i ↪ M, one toward each world

portals.description: portal morphisms ψ_i : Q_i → W_i into each world of the family
